aggregation_order: negative candidate mean within directed endpoint challenge
target homologous superfamily mean within anchor
anchor mean within source dependency cluster and source-SF/topology stratum
dependency-cluster weighted mean within source-SF/topology stratum

coverage.missing_duplicate_nonfinite_or_zero_norm: abort; no runtime pruning or redraw

numerical_precision: embedding input converted to float64; all normalization, cosine, aggregation, and quantiles in float64

primary_evaluation.similarity: cosine dot product after L2 normalization

primary_score.semantics: formal F-only relation score: win=1, tie=0, loss=-1; all prescribed hierarchy means and bootstrap draws are in F space

scope_note: Public F-only implementation of the prescribed hierarchy and global dependency-cluster Bayesian bootstrap.

uncertainty.invalid_draw_policy: any nonfinite or nonpositive generated weight or incomplete hierarchy aborts the run
uncertainty.reason: positive global weights preserve the frozen source-SF/topology composition when strata may contain one dependency cluster; no independent within-stratum resampling
uncertainty.shared_weight_rule: one cluster weight is reused in every source-SF/topology stratum containing that cluster
uncertainty.weight_draw: one iid Exponential(1) positive weight per global dependency cluster per draw; equivalently normalized Dirichlet(1,...,1) weights
